first.orig: מתקפת הפתע על ישראל (מכונה גם טבח 7 באוקטובר, טבח שמחת תורה והשבת השחורה) הייתה מתקפה רחבת היקף של חמאס וארגוני טרור פלסטינים נוספים מרצועת עזה על ישראל, נגד יעדים צבאיים ואזרחיים, במיוחד בעוטף עזה, שהחלה בבוקר יום שבת 7 באוקטובר 2023, שמיני עצרת ה'תשפ"ד.
first.tr: The surprise attack on Israel (also called the 7 October massacre, the Simchat Torah massacre and Black Sabbath) was a large-scale attack by Hamas and other Palestinian terror organisations from the Gaza Strip on Israel, against military and civilian targets, especially in the Gaza envelope, which began on the morning of Saturday 7 October 2023, Shemini Atzeret 5784.

latest.orig: טבח שבעה באוקטובר היה מתקפת פתע רחבת היקף שביצעו ארגוני הטרור הפלסטיני מרצועת עזה נגד יעדים אזרחיים וצבאיים בישראל.
latest.tr: The Seventh of October massacre was a large-scale surprise attack carried out by the Palestinian terror organisations from the Gaza Strip against civilian and military targets in Israel.

first.orig: هي عمليةٌ عسكرية مُمتدة شنَّتها فصائلُ المقاومة الفلسطينية في قطاع غزة وعَلى رأسِها حركة حماس عَبر ذراعها العسكري كتائب الشهيد عز الدّين القسام
first.tr: is an extended military operation launched by the Palestinian resistance factions in the Gaza Strip, headed by the Hamas movement through its military arm, the Martyr Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades

latest.orig: تُشير جميعها إلى العملية العسكرية الممتدّة التي شنّتها فصائل المقاومة الفلسطينية في قطاع غزة بقيادة حركة حماس على الاحتلال الإسرائيلي
latest.tr: all refer to the extended military operation launched by the Palestinian resistance factions in the Gaza Strip, led by the Hamas movement, against the Israeli occupation

first.orig: On 7 October 2023, the paramilitary wings of Hamas, the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, the PFLP, and the DFLP launched a series of coordinated armed incursions into the Gaza envelope of neighboring Israeli territory, the first invasion of Israel since the 1948 Arab–Israeli War.
first.tr: On 7 October 2023, the paramilitary wings of Hamas, the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, the PFLP, and the DFLP launched a series of coordinated armed incursions into the Gaza envelope of neighboring Israeli territory, the first invasion of Israel since the 1948 Arab–Israeli War.

latest.orig: On October 7, 2023, a series of coordinated armed incursions from the blockaded Gaza Strip into the Gaza envelope of southern Israel were carried out by Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups killing at least 1,195 people during the Jewish holiday of Simchat Torah.
latest.tr: On October 7, 2023, a series of coordinated armed incursions from the blockaded Gaza Strip into the Gaza envelope of southern Israel were carried out by Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups killing at least 1,195 people during the Jewish holiday of Simchat Torah.

first.orig: Der Terrorangriff der Hamas auf Israel 2023 am 7. Oktober 2023 war ein terroristischer Überfall unter Führung der radikal-islamistischen Hamas der vom Gazastreifen aus gegen Israel verübt wurde.
first.tr: The Hamas terror attack on Israel 2023 on 7 October 2023 was a terrorist assault led by the radical-Islamist Hamas, perpetrated from the Gaza Strip against Israel.

latest.orig: Der Terrorangriff der Hamas auf Israel 2023 (auch vereinfacht 7. Oktober) war mit 1195 überwiegend jüdischen Todesopfern das größte Massaker und Verbrechen gegen die Menschlichkeit an Juden seit dem Holocaust.
latest.tr: The Hamas terror attack on Israel 2023 (also simply 7 October) was, with 1195 predominantly Jewish fatalities, the largest massacre and crime against humanity against Jews since the Holocaust.

first.orig: Lattaque du Hamas contre Israël est une série d'attaques terroristes coordonnées, menées majoritairement par le Hamas depuis la bande de Gaza vers les zones frontalières d'Israël, et qui commence le, jour de Shabbat et jour de la fête de Sim'hat Torah.
first.tr: The Hamas attack against Israel is a series of coordinated terrorist attacks, carried out mainly by Hamas from the Gaza Strip towards the border areas of Israel, and which begins on [7 October 2023], a Shabbat day and the day of the Simchat Torah holiday.

latest.orig: Lattaque du Hamas contre Israël d'octobre 2023 est une série d'attentats terroristes palestiniens contre des localités civiles et bases militaires israéliennes du pourtour de la bande de Gaza.
latest.tr: The Hamas attack against Israel of October 2023 is a series of Palestinian terrorist attacks [attentats] against Israeli civilian localities and military bases around the Gaza Strip.

first.orig: Operación Inundación de Al-Aqsa (en árabe: عملية طوفان الأقصى, en hebreo: מבצע מבול אל-אקצא o מתקפת הפתע על ישראל) es el nombre utilizado por el grupo militante islamista palestino Hamás para sus incursiones coordinadas desde la Franja de Gaza a zonas fronterizas con Israel realizadas el 7 de octubre de 2023.
first.tr: Operation Al-Aqsa Flood (in Arabic: ..., in Hebrew: ... or 'the surprise attack on Israel') is the name used by the Palestinian Islamist militant group Hamas for its coordinated incursions from the Gaza Strip into border areas with Israel carried out on 7 October 2023.

latest.orig: Los ataques del 7 de octubre contra Israel, como son conocidos internacionalmente y denominados así por medios de comunicación, organizaciones internacionales y gobiernos, denominados operación Inundación de Al-Aqsa por los palestinos, fueron una serie de ataques coordinados realizados por Hamás desde la Franja de Gaza en zonas fronterizas con Israel.
latest.tr: The 7 October attacks against Israel, as they are known internationally and so named by the media, international organisations and governments, named Operation Al-Aqsa Flood by the Palestinians, were a series of coordinated attacks carried out by Hamas from the Gaza Strip on border areas with Israel.

first.orig: Lattacco di Hamas a Israele del 2023, o operazione alluvione Al-Aqsa (in arabo:عملية طوفان الأقصى, ʿamaliyyat ṭūfān al-ʾAqṣā), è stato costituito da una serie di offensive militari, attacchi terroristici e massacri di civili e militari, avvenuti il 7 ottobre 2023 nel territorio di Israele, da parte di Hamas, con il supporto di altri gruppi terroristici palestinesi.
first.tr: The 2023 Hamas attack on Israel, or Operation Al-Aqsa Flood (...), consisted of a series of military offensives, terrorist attacks and massacres of civilians and soldiers, which took place on 7 October 2023 on the territory of Israel, by Hamas, with the support of other Palestinian terrorist groups.

latest.orig: Lattacco di Hamas a Israele del 2023, ovvero Operazione Diluvio al-Aqṣā, è consistito in una serie di attacchi terroristici di gruppi armati, provenienti dalla Striscia di Gaza, con conseguente uccisione di almeno 1200 civili e militari israeliani, e nel rapimento di circa 250 di questi, avvenuto il 7 ottobre 2023 nel territorio di Israele, pianificato e operato da Ḥamās, con il sostegno di altre milizie palestinesi.
latest.tr: The 2023 Hamas attack on Israel, i.e. Operation Al-Aqsa Flood, consisted of a series of terrorist attacks by armed groups, coming from the Gaza Strip, with the consequent killing of at least 1200 Israeli civilians and soldiers, and the kidnapping of about 250 of them, which took place on 7 October 2023 on the territory of Israel, planned and operated by Hamas, with the support of other Palestinian militias.

first.orig: Uma série de ataques coordenados, conduzidos pelo grupo militante islâmico palestino Hamas, da Faixa de Gaza às áreas fronteiriças de Israel, começaram no sábado, 7 de outubro de 2023, um sábado e data de vários feriados judaicos.
first.tr: A series of coordinated attacks, conducted by the Palestinian Islamic militant group Hamas, from the Gaza Strip into the border areas of Israel, began on Saturday, 7 October 2023, a Sabbath and date of several Jewish holidays.

latest.orig: Os ataques de 7 de outubro de 2023 a Israel, ou simplesmente ataques de 7 de outubro, foram uma série de atentados coordenados e conduzidos pelo grupo militante islâmico palestino Hamas, da Faixa de Gaza, às áreas fronteiriças do sul de Israel, na manhã de sabá, data de vários feriados judaicos.
latest.tr: The 7 October 2023 attacks on Israel, or simply 7 October attacks, were a series of coordinated attacks [atentados] conducted by the Palestinian Islamic militant group Hamas, from the Gaza Strip, into the border areas of southern Israel, on the morning of the Sabbath, date of several Jewish holidays.

first.orig: De Hamas-aanval in Israël in 2023 was een gecoördineerde verrassingsaanval door de militante beweging Hamas vanuit de Gazastrook op Israël, onder de naam Operatie Al-Aqsa-storm.
first.tr: The 2023 Hamas attack in Israel was a coordinated surprise attack by the militant movement Hamas from the Gaza Strip on Israel, under the name Operation Al-Aqsa Storm.

latest.orig: De Hamas-aanval in Israël in 2023 was een gecoördineerde verrassingsaanval of terreuraanslag door Hamas en andere gewapende groeperingen vanuit de Gazastrook op Israël.
latest.tr: The 2023 Hamas attack in Israel was a coordinated surprise attack or terror attack by Hamas and other armed groups from the Gaza Strip on Israel.

first.orig: Вторжение группировки ХАМАС в Израиль (названное ей операцией «Наводнение Аль-Акса», ) началось 7 октября 2023 года, когда палестинские вооружённые группировки, возглавляемые ХАМАС, вторглись в Израиль из сектора Газа, прорвав пограничный барьер и проникнув в близлежащие израильские населённые пункты и на военные объекты.
first.tr: The invasion of Israel by the HAMAS group (called by it Operation "Al-Aqsa Flood") began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian armed groups led by HAMAS invaded Israel from the Gaza Strip, breaking through the border barrier and penetrating nearby Israeli localities and military facilities.

latest.orig: Вторжение группировки ХАМАС в Израиль (названное ею операцией «Наводнение аль-Акса», ) началось 7 октября 2023 года, когда палестинские вооружённые группировки, возглавляемые ХАМАС, проникли на территорию Израиля из сектора Газа, прорвав пограничный барьер и войдя в близлежащие израильские населённые пункты и на военные объекты.
latest.tr: The invasion of Israel by the HAMAS group (called by it Operation "al-Aqsa Flood") began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian armed groups led by HAMAS penetrated the territory of Israel from the Gaza Strip, breaking through the border barrier and entering nearby Israeli localities and military facilities.
